planets.name: TOI-2049 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2049 with a 5.3-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-2049 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-2049. Its orbit and size follow Guenther et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname GUENTHER_ET_AL_2026): disc_year 2026, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 5.303468, pl_radj 1.485, pl_bmassj 1.53
